payload.title: Reduce agent harness to two PHP-only agents (user support + admin), remove handoffs and browser deps
payload.body:
## Summary
Strip the agent harness down to two PHP-only agents.

## Target state
Keep exactly two:
1. **User support agent** — customer-facing support assistant.
2. **Admin agent** — answers owner questions about products, orders, users, revenue and status.

Both must run purely in PHP. No browser automation and no external runtime dependencies.

## Remove
- `.agents/handoffs/`, `.agents/workflows/`, `.agents/ops/`, the subagent orchestration skill
- The handoff GitHub Actions (`issue-agent-trigger`, `issue-comment-handoff`, `ai-pr-review`) and `cli/handoff.php`
- Browser-dependent tooling: `.bin/download-chrome.php`, `.bin/launch-chrome.sh`, `cli/pma-client.php` (drives phpMyAdmin through Playwright)
- The admin AI agent form and the current support bot wiring, replaced by the two agents above

## Keep
Per explicit instruction, retain the CLI needed for coding-agent work: map generation, schema listing, DB query, and blog update commands.

## Care required
- `app/routes.php` currently reads its route table from `ProjectMapService::registry()`. Anything touching `ProjectMapService` must keep routing intact — extract the route array first if that service is reduced.
- `cli/process-mail-queue.php` is very likely a production cron. Do not remove it.
- `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` must be updated in the same change, since `AGENTS.md` currently documents the handoff chain as binding.

## Acceptance checks
- [ ] Exactly two agents remain, both pure PHP
- [ ] No browser or Playwright dependency anywhere in the runtime or CLI
- [ ] Routing still works after any `ProjectMapService` reduction
- [ ] Mail queue cron still present
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` no longer describes a workflow that does not exist
